# EVIT Organization

EVIT is an IT sales and lead generation consulting firm specializing in helping B2B IT service providers, software development companies, and technical founders scale revenue and expand globally.

## Key Information
- Focus: B2B IT Services and Tech Companies.
- Core System: G.O.D. Sales System (Generate, Optimize, Deliver).
- Services: Global Expansion Strategy, Outbound Sales Development, Sales Team Enablement, Content & Tech Marketing.
- Target Markets: Europe (Nordic, DACH, UK, etc.), US, Canada, APAC.
- Value Proposition: Build predictable pipelines, acquire international clients, and achieve independent sales execution.
